intelligence.essence:
Back, Forward, and Keep Reading (Next) — three buttons only, nice and clean at the bottom, extraordinary, elite, high-tech, using the SAME buttons the Hub uses (the collective / personal / activity style). The current buttons are "not elite level." This order supersedes the earlier "Keep Reading + little Back, no bottom bar" spec.

His sharpening, minutes later in the main chat: the back and forward are symbols, not words — one on one side, one on the other — and "next" sits in the middle. Nice little buttons that look pro, and not jammed together: "These are not together."
